sources.current_semantic_source_note: Runtime src/resdag and executable Python/Julia benchmark sources are byte-identical between these commits. Test fixtures and documentation changed. These scores remain measurements of dcedbba; later reproduction-CLI or documentation work is not a new measured execution.
sources.public_summary_kind: Curated derived evidence. No original sealed artifact was modified; local paths, imported-module inventories, full transient trial attributes and binary arrays/checkpoints are omitted.

protocol.window_indexing: Zero-based sample indices; training, validation and test intervals are half-open [start, stop).
protocol.valid_horizon_steps: First step index whose normalized error is nonfinite or >= threshold; if none, the complete horizon length. Forecasts are scored individually before pooling.
protocol.scale_definition: Fixed population standard deviation (correction=0) of admitted training labels after washout: raw[washout+1:training_stop], washout=500, next-sample lead=1. Constant channels use 1; nonconstant scales have a dtype-epsilon floor. No validation or test values determine the scales.
protocol.prediction_units: Original signal units; training-only learned preprocessing.
protocol.lyapunov_time_definition: steps * dt * lambda_max; fixed reference exponents in each system protocol, not newly estimated per trajectory.
protocol.censoring_definition: right_censored=true when valid_steps equals horizon_steps; those reported horizons and their censored aggregate limits are lower bounds.
protocol.selection_objective: Median of nine valid-horizon scores across three initialization seeds and three chronological validation origins, threshold 0.3.
protocol.summary_aggregation: Pooled median/min/max over 15 individual forecasts per system/family/variant; five per-seed medians are also retained. A pooled median can differ from the median of per-seed medians.
protocol.validation_and_refit: Explicit chronological validation is held out from fitting and final refit. All four winners froze before reserved final evaluation; no after-test retuning.
protocol.history_conditioning: Each origin uses all earlier observed samples as history and then rolls autonomously for at least 10 Lyapunov times. Later origins may use prior observed test samples as context; model fitting remains training-only.
protocol.novelty_boundary: Raw trajectories, initial conditions and chronological origins were used in prior experiments and are historically known. Fresh reserved initialization seeds only; one trajectory per system. No independent-trajectory generalization claim.

capability_family.classic: tanh leaky reservoir; readout features concatenate current input with reservoir state; fitted unpenalized readout intercept.
capability_family.ott: tanh leaky reservoir; alternate reservoir coordinates are squared, then concatenated with current input; fitted unpenalized readout intercept.
capability_family.readout: SVD ridge, CPU float64; per-candidate alpha; frozen reservoir.
capability_family.reservoir: Directed Erdos-Renyi recurrence, self-loops allowed, independent Bernoulli edges at p=degree/width; separate deterministic initialization roles.
capability_family.reservoir_bias: Random uniform[-bias_scale,bias_scale], not a constant offset.
capability_family.difference_from_equal_time_protocol: This explicit classic/OTT capability experiment uses an input skip and a readout intercept. The separate equal-time cross-library comparison uses a common state-only/no-intercept vanilla family. Their scores and model families must not be conflated.

parameter_names.degree: expected recurrent entries per row, including permitted self-loop

protocol.trial_failure_policy: 24 attempts per study without replacement or pruning; failed configurations remain failures and do not count as complete nine-run checks. Winning trials must be COMPLETE.

array_and_record_layout.fit_seconds: Stored once per case_fit_observations entry; the original report repeats the same single fit observation on its three forecast rows.
array_and_record_layout.full_horizon_nrmse: Shared by both threshold scores and stored once per forecast; original 0.3/0.5 values were asserted identical.
array_and_record_layout.forecasts: Every original 150 final row is retained; no binary arrays are included.

protocol.timing_boundary: Fit/forecast seconds are observations from concurrent correctness/quality work, not controlled speed evidence. No timing ranking or causal old/new initialization attribution follows from this capability experiment.

tune.verification_boundary: Observed native API settings on the synchronous calling thread; not an OS/kernel thread-occupancy measurement.

after.verification_boundary: Observed native API settings on the synchronous calling thread; not an OS/kernel thread-occupancy measurement.

stored_checkpoint_parity.boundary: Four existing materialized 4.1.0 winner checkpoints, reloaded for three observed histories each. This proves stored tensor/history-conditioned forecast parity for these cases; it does not prove new-seed equality, arbitrary online continuation, or RNG continuation without history.

limitations: Vanilla Rossler pooled median 4.203318 LT at 0.3 and 4.234377 LT at 0.5 misses 7-8 LT; no post-test winner replacement or retuning.
One historically known trajectory per system; initialization seeds 401-405 were reserved. Shared seeds and history make the 15 forecasts dependent.
No independent-trajectory generalization, superiority of default tuning, universal forecast guarantee or causal attribution of old/new score differences to RNG alone.
Lorenz classic pooled median reaches 10.015936 LT, but the median of its five per-seed medians is 8.856768 LT; both summaries remain visible.
Full horizons are 553 steps for Lorenz and 966 for Rossler; right-censored outcomes are lower bounds, not measured exact horizons beyond those limits.
Public JSON preserves recorded metrics and immutable-source hashes; independently re-running models or verifying scales from raw arrays is outside this lightweight export.
